# Azure AI Services — Search, Speech & OpenAI

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's guide to the four core Azure AI services: AI Search (full-text, vector and hybrid search with AI enrichment), Speech (real-time and batch speech-to-text, neural text-to-speech, speaker diarization), Azure OpenAI (GPT models, embeddings) and Document Intelligence (form extraction, OCR), with MCP tools and CLI fallbacks plus condensed SDK references for Python, TypeScript, .NET and Java. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: every AI call is metered — embeddings, transcription minutes and OpenAI tokens bill per use, so prototype against small datasets; vector search requires an AI Search service with vector support enabled. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
